def test_owner_stored():
    cart = ShoppingCart('Ana')
    assert cart.owner == 'Ana', 'owner must be stored'

def test_items_default_empty():

    assert cart.items == [], 'items must default to an empty list'

def test_items_are_independent_per_instance():
    cart1 = ShoppingCart('Ana')
    cart2 = ShoppingCart('Bo')
    cart1.items.append('apple')
